newsitem.title: USA: FORECAST - Distillate draw seen in APIs due to cold.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Distillate draw seen in APIs due to cold.

text.p: The American Petroleum Institute (API) is expected by traders to report a draw in distillate stocks Tuesday after a cold spell in the U.S. Northeast last week had consumers restocking heating oil.

"There was the cold weather last week, but also those who have 275 gallon (heating oil) tanks are now having to fill up again," said Peter Beutel, energy analyst and president of Cameron Hanover in Bronxville, N.Y.
Distillate stocks, which include heating oil and diesel, are expected to drop by a half million to one million barrels.
